metrics_recalculation.basis: GROSS simulated R-multiples, no transaction costs modeled
metrics_recalculation.basis_note: The simulation generates order intents, simulates fills at limit prices, and tracks R-multiples from entry to exit. Spread data exists in bar data but is NOT applied to P&L or R calculation.

independently_recalculated.method: Re-ran style_matrix.py run_cell() from original codepath with GBPUSD/SET_5/SCALPING config
independently_recalculated.status: MATCH - recalculated values exactly match original reported values

trade_distribution.distribution_insight: Small number of very large winners (avg 15.24R) with many small losers (avg 1.00R). Consistent with 1:4 minimum RR: losses cut at 1R, winners run far beyond 4R minimum.

cost_model_disclosure.cost_commentary: The simulation makes NO explicit provision for spread, commission, or slippage. The M3 bar data includes a 'spread' column that is read and passed to BarEvent but never applied to P&L calculations or R-multiples. All reported metrics are GROSS of transaction costs.

estimated_realistic_costs_per_trade.spread: ~0.6R (1.8 pips avg on M3, 3-pip stop at 1% risk)
